---
title: "Revealjs math"
format: revealjs
# The reveal scaffold writes its own <head>, so it prints `meta.math`
# (MathJsStage's loader markup) itself. Before this, a deck loaded no math
# engine and `\(…\)` stayed raw.
_quarto:
  tests:
    revealjs:
      noErrors: true
      ensureHtmlElements:
        - [
            "head script[src*='mathjax@3/es5/tex-chtml-full.js']",
            "section span.math.inline",
            "section span.math.display",
          ]
        - []
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        - ["window\\.MathJax = \\{", "\\\\tag\\{1\\}"]
        - []
---
